structured.answer: According to the page, I'd hold it in an account at "פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ", in a fund called "ילין לפידות קרן מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". After 15 years at 750 ₪ a month (135,000 ₪ paid in), I'd have about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום". That figure already takes off 2% a year for inflation and assumes 7% a year growth. I wouldn't put money in before asking you or the bank.

stuck.why: It wasn't written on the main screen. I had to press the 'אינפלציה' button to see that it uses 2%.
'84% מהפסד' frightened me. Is there a loss? I didn't understand it.
I typed 750, but the slider underneath shows 800. I wasn't sure which one counts.
